opportunities.title: Medspa Pilot Sales Partner Needed
opportunities.description: Freelance Sales & Pilot Acquisition Partner — Agenzo Agenzo is looking for a performance-based freelance sales partner to help us acquire our first few pilot customers in the US medspa and aesthetic clinic market. What you'll do - Research and identify qualified medspas and aesthetic clinics. - Reach out to clinic owners, founders, and decision-makers. - Set up sales/discovery meetings with qualified prospects. - Join the meetings with me and actively help present Agenzo. - Help handle objections, communicate the value proposition, and move qualified prospects toward a pilot. - Follow up with prospects after meetings and help drive deals toward closing. - Work closely with me throughout the entire sales process. Compensation This is a 100% performance-based opportunity with no fixed salary. You will receive 20% commission on the pilot payment actually received by Agenzo for every pilot customer you directly help acquire and close. Commission is paid only after: 1. The customer agrees to the pilot. 2. The customer has completed the required agreement/onboarding. 3. Agenzo has received the customer's full pilot payment. There is no commission for simply booking a meeting or generating a lead. If the initial meetings go exceptionally well and I feel we're a strong fit to work together, the commission percentage can be increased based on performance and future responsibilities. Ideal candidate - Strong B2B sales/outbound experience. - Comfortable speaking directly with business owners and decision-makers. - Experience selling SaaS, AI, automation, healthcare technology, or similar products is a strong advantage. - Excellent communication and objection-handling skills. - Strong spoken English. - US B2B sales experience is highly preferred. - Self-motivated and comfortable working on a performance-only basis. Why join Agenzo? You'll work directly with the founder rather than simply handing off leads. You'll be involved in the actual sales conversations, demos, objection handling, and closing process. If you're good at what you do, there is significant room for the relationship to grow as Agenzo scales. The goal is simple: find the right clinics, get them into the conversation, help close the pilot, and earn when the customer actually pays.

opportunities.title: Jet-Powered 350Z Instagram Reel
opportunities.description: I have six freshly-shot 4 K S-Log3 clips of our wide-body, turbofan-equipped Nissan 350Z that need to be cut into a single 9:16 Reel between 10 and 20 seconds long. The footage covers slow orbits of the carbon hood and bronze wheels, a macro of the turbine housing and roll cage, cockpit switch-flips, the spool-up with a fireball, a high-speed fly-by, and a sunset hero shot. The look I’m after is cinematic and dramatic—clean, purposeful edits that breathe with the real jet-engine audio instead of gimmicky transitions or canned templates. Colour grading is essential; the flame burst must stay rich and detailed (our last pass blew it out to white). Source details: two Sony bodies, some clips at 60 fps, others at 24 fps, all roughly forty seconds total. Please stabilise only where it adds value, sync the authentic engine note, and keep cuts tight to the beat of the car, not a stock rhythm track. Deliverables • 10-20 s vertical (1080 × 1920) master ready for Instagram Reels • One graded 4 K archive render for my records • Project file or edit decision list so we can tweak later if needed
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40808631, publicado hace 3 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 30 - 250.

opportunities.title: Multilingual 3D Cartoon Pilot Animation
opportunities.description: AI-Assisted 3D Cartoon Animation for Multilingual Children’s Educational Series Budget: €800–€1,200 | Fixed Price Project Description We are looking for a talented freelancer or small animation studio to create a high-quality, AI-assisted 3D-style cartoon pilot for an upcoming international children’s educational project. The videos will be designed for children aged 3–6. Our goal is to develop a professional animated series that can later be adapted into multiple languages and distributed internationally. We are looking for a creative partner interested in long-term collaboration. Pilot Episode Requirements * Duration: 60–90 seconds * High-quality, colorful, child-friendly 3D cartoon style * Two original animated animal characters * Consistent character appearance across all scenes * Natural movements, facial expressions and simple lip-sync * Professional voice-over in two languages * Background music and sound effects with commercial usage rights * Full HD (1920 × 1080), MP4 format * One revision round included Important: Multilingual Expansion The series is intended to expand into multiple languages in the future. The production workflow must therefore allow: * Reusing the same characters and animation assets across different language versions * Replacing voice-overs without recreating the entire video * Adjusting lip-sync for different languages where needed * Creating additional episodes with consistent character designs * Adding new characters and languages in future seasons * Delivering reusable project files and character assets where technically possible We are looking for a scalable and cost-effective production solution. Required Skills * AI-assisted animation and 3D cartoon production * Consistent character design * Experience with Runway, Kling, Blender or similar tools * Multilingual voice-over integration * Video editing and sound design * Experience producing children’s content is preferred Please Include in Your Proposal 1. Examples of similar animation projects. 2. Your fixed price for the pilot episode. 3. Estimated delivery time. 4. Which tools and workflow you recommend. 5. How you would maintain character consistency across future episodes. 6. Whether existing animations can be reused for additional languages. 7. The estimated cost of creating an additional language version. 8. The estimated cost of producing additional episodes. 9. Which commercial usage rights, character assets and editable project files are included. 10. Whether you can also assist with website integration and online publishing. Confidentiality The full project concept, character names, scripts and business details are confidential and will only be shared with shortlisted candidates after signing a non-disclosure agreement (NDA). We would like to begin with a small paid animation test before commissioning the complete pilot episode. We are interested in a reliable long-term production partner. Please send your portfolio, proposed workflow and fixed-price quotation.

opportunities.title: Aplikasi Manajemen Tugas Multi-Tim
opportunities.description: Saya ingin mempercepat dan mempermudah cara kami mengatur tugas serta jadwal untuk banyak staf yang bekerja di beberapa tim. Saat ini semuanya masih di-excel dan grup chat, sehingga sering terlambat dan sulit dilacak. Saya membutuhkan sebuah platform terpusat di mana setiap orang bisa: • Menerima penugasan dengan tenggat dan prioritas yang jelas. • Melihat kalender tim yang otomatis sinkron ketika ada perubahan. • Menerima notifikasi instan (email, push, atau WhatsApp) saat ada tugas baru atau jadwal bergeser. • Melaporkan progres secara real-time sehingga manajer dapat memantau beban kerja dan tenggat yang terlewat. • Beroperasi dengan hak akses bertingkat (admin, leader, anggota) agar data tetap aman antar-tim. • Mengekspor laporan ke Excel/CSV untuk rekap bulanan. Preferensi teknis: – Boleh web-based dengan tampilan mobile-friendly; opsi aplikasi native ringan juga dipertimbangkan. – Dapat di-hosting di server Linux kami atau cloud umum. – Antarmuka harus cukup intuitif untuk dipelajari dalam ±15 menit oleh pengguna non-teknis. Deliverable yang saya harapkan: 1. Prototype fungsional (front-end & back-end) siap uji coba. 2. Dokumentasi instalasi serta panduan pengguna singkat. 3. Kode sumber lengkap untuk kami kembangkan lebih lanjut. Pengalaman membangun sistem serupa dengan stack populer (Laravel, Node.js, React, Flutter, dsb.) menjadi nilai tambah. Sertakan contoh proyek relevan ketika mengajukan penawaran.

opportunities.title: MEP Engineer Needed for Design
opportunities.description: I have a new construction project moving into the design phase and I need a qualified MEP engineer to take charge of the mechanical, electrical and plumbing plans. At this stage I have architectural PDFs and a preliminary structural layout; what I’m missing is a coordinated MEP package that my builder and the local authority can rely on. Scope • Review the architectural and structural files I provide (DWG and PDF). • Develop properly coordinated mechanical, electrical and plumbing layouts—including equipment schedules, load calculations and single-line diagrams—so everything fits both spatially and technically. • Produce drawings ready for permit submission as well as clean construction-issue sets in AutoCAD or Revit, plus PDFs. • Remain available for one revision round after the first review to resolve any comments from the municipality or my GC. Acceptance criteria • All drawings follow the latest local code references I will supply. • Files are delivered in native CAD/Revit format and PDF. • Clash-free coordination among M, E and P disciplines. If your background covers full-cycle MEP design and you are comfortable collaborating remotely—screen-shares, quick calls, marked-up PDFs—please let me know your typical turnaround time and any comparable projects you have completed.

opportunities.title: Snack Pouch Packaging Design
opportunities.description: I need an eye-catching, retail-ready design for a new snack / confectionery line that will be sold in a flexible bag-style pouch. Clear, playful shelf impact is essential while still meeting food-grade labelling standards. i have ai generated image references for sample design. Scope • Develop the full pouch layout—front, back, gussets—and incorporate space for logo, flavour name, ingredients, nutrition panel, barcode, and mandatory regulatory text. • Build the design around the final dieline (I can supply the printer’s dieline template as soon as the project starts). • Colour palette and typography should feel fun and indulgent but remain legible at small sizes. • Supply two visual variations so I can choose a direction, then refine the selected option through up to two rounds of revisions. Deliverables • Print-ready files (Adobe Illustrator or layered PDF with outlined fonts and linked graphics) • High-resolution 3D mock-ups for presentation • Editable source file for future flavour extensions Acceptance Criteria 1. Files match the provided dieline to the millimetre. 2. CMYK colours, minimum 300 dpi images, and 3 mm bleed included. 3. All regulatory text fits within allocated zones and remains legible at 100% scale. I’m ready to share the logo assets and flavour copy right away and can respond quickly to questions during the design phase.

opportunities.title: Build AI B2B Market Intelligence Platform
opportunities.description: # Job Title **Senior Python Data Engineer & AI Business Intelligence Platform Developer — B2B Market Intelligence, Data Pipelines & AI** ## About Our Business Vidya Timber is a family-owned plywood, timber and interior materials business based in Varanasi, India. We are expanding into modular interiors and developing our premium architectural door brand, Archwood. We are looking to build an AI-powered B2B Market Intelligence Platform that helps our sales team discover potential customers, identify construction projects, understand business relationships and prioritize high-value commercial opportunities. We are looking for an experienced technical professional who can build a reliable, scalable and production-ready platform—not just a prototype, chatbot or basic lead-generation tool. ## Project Vision The platform should help us identify: - Architects and architecture firms - Interior designers - Builders and real estate developers - Contractors and construction companies - Plywood, timber and building-material dealers - Publicly announced construction and real estate projects The long-term objective is to transform publicly available business intelligence into actionable sales opportunities for Vidya Timber and Archwood. ## Core Responsibilities ### 1. B2B Business Intelligence Data Collection - Develop reliable data pipelines using Python. - Collect publicly available business information from relevant sources. - Explore sources such as Google Maps, company websites, project portfolios, public RERA records, government project announcements, news publications and business directories. - Discover construction projects in Varanasi and Uttar Pradesh, including projects not yet listed on RERA. - Maintain source URLs, discovery dates and verification status for collected records. - Implement deduplication, data cleaning and enrichment workflows. - Respect website terms, applicable laws, privacy requirements and data access restrictions. ### 2. Database & Data Engineering - Design a structured PostgreSQL database. - Build relationships between companies, people, projects and business activities. - Implement data validation and quality checks. - Maintain a reliable data ingestion and update process. - Design the system for future expansion across multiple cities and states. ### 3. AI-Powered Intelligence - Use LLMs for extracting structured information from public sources. - Implement AI-assisted company enrichment and opportunity identification. - Develop transparent lead scoring based on business relevance and evidence. - Generate actionable reports explaining why a prospect is valuable. - Explore RAG, GraphRAG and AI agents where they provide measurable value. **Important:** We do not want unnecessary AI complexity. The developer should recommend the right architecture based on actual business requirements. ### 4. Working Business Intelligence Dashboard Develop a functional web application that allows our sales team to: - Search and filter prospects. - View company profiles and associated projects. - Understand relationships between architects, builders and contractors. - View lead scores with explanations. - See original source references. - Record calls, follow-ups, notes and sales outcomes. - Export prospect data to CSV or Excel. - Identify the next recommended sales action. ### 5. AI Agents & Future Integrations The platform should eventually support: - Scheduled intelligence collection. - AI-assisted research workflows. - CRM integrations. - Sales reporting. - MCP server integrations where useful. - Automated business opportunity alerts. ## Preferred Technical Skills **Essential:** - Python - PostgreSQL - Data engineering and ETL pipelines - Web data extraction using appropriate tools such as Scrapy or Playwright - API development using FastAPI or similar - Data cleaning, matching, deduplication and validation - Full-stack dashboard development - Production deployment and documentation **Preferred:** - LLM integrations: Claude, OpenAI or Gemini - LangGraph or similar workflow orchestration - RAG and GraphRAG - Knowledge graphs - MCP servers - n8n - Cloud deployment: AWS, GCP or equivalent - B2B lead generation and business intelligence systems ## Initial Scope — 30-Day MVP We want to begin with Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh. The first phase should deliver: 1. A working PostgreSQL database. 2. A structured database of relevant local businesses. 3. Source-backed company and project records. 4. A basic relationship mapping system. 5. Transparent lead scoring. 6. A functional sales dashboard. 7. Prospect search, filtering and follow-up tracking. 8. CSV/Excel export. 9. A documented data collection and validation pipeline. 10. A live demonstration of the working platform. We expect a phased approach. The first milestone should be a focused pilot before expanding the system. ## Deliverables - Complete source code. - Database schema and data models. - Working dashboard and backend. - Data collection and enrichment pipelines. - AI workflows, if applicable. - Deployment configuration. - Technical documentation. - Setup instructions. - Testing and validation. - Project handover. All project-specific source code, databases, documentation and deliverables must be owned by Vidya Timber. Third-party tools and services should be clearly documented. ## Who We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who: - Has built production-grade data pipelines or business intelligence systems. - Can demonstrate relevant completed projects. - Understands the difference between collecting leads and generating actionable intelligence. - Can explain technical decisions in business terms. - Is capable of working independently. - Is interested in a long-term technical partnership. - Can begin with a paid pilot and scale based on results. We are not looking for someone who only builds basic chatbots, generic CRM systems or AI demos. ## Application Questions Please answer the following questions in your proposal: 1. Describe one production-grade B2B data pipeline or business intelligence platform you have developed. 2. How would you discover construction projects in Varanasi and Uttar Pradesh beyond RERA databases? 3. How would you connect architects, builders, contractors and construction projects in a relational database? 4. Would you recommend GraphRAG for the MVP? Why or why not? 5. How would you estimate the potential demand for doors and interior materials from a construction project? 6. What would you include in a 60-hour pilot? 7. What is your estimated timeline and budget for a 30-day MVP? 8. What would the estimated monthly infrastructure and AI API costs be? 9. Can you demonstrate a working production project? 10. Will you personally develop the system, or will other team members be involved? ## Engagement We prefer a paid initial pilot with clearly defined deliverables and milestones. Successful execution may lead to a long-term engagement involving expansion across Uttar Pradesh and additional AI-powered business intelligence capabilities. Please include your hourly rate, estimated hours, proposed architecture and relevant portfolio links. **Our priority is data quality, actionable business intelligence, reliability and measurable commercial value—not unnecessary technical complexity.**

opportunities.title: Manufacturing-Ready NX 3D Model
opportunities.description: I’ll send you a dimensioned PDF of a machined part that needs to be rebuilt from scratch in Siemens NX. The finished files must be ready for the shop floor, so accuracy and clean parametric work are essential. Deliverables • Native NX (.prt) 3D model, fully constrained and editable • Complete 2D manufacturing drawings extracted from the model, with every dimension, tolerance, and call-out copied from the PDF • CNC-ready output (STEP/IGES and CL data or similar) that a machinist can load without further tweaks Everything has to match the source print exactly and follow standard machining practice—no missing fillets, draft angles, or hole notes. Keep the file structure tidy and name parts clearly so future revisions are simple. If any detail on the PDF looks ambiguous, point it out before modeling so we avoid rework. Let me know how soon you can turn this around and share an example of a comparable project you’ve completed in NX.

opportunities.title: Product Research & Sourcing Executive
opportunities.description: You need a Full-Time Product Research & Procurement Executive for your Bangalore business. This person will be responsible for finding winning products across India, researching manufacturers, negotiating prices, and getting products delivered to your store. Job Description – Product Research & Sourcing Executive Hiring: Product Research & Sourcing Executive **Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka\ **Job Type:** Full-Time | Work from Office About the Role We are looking for a dedicated Product Research & Sourcing Executive who can identify high-potential, trending, and profitable products across India and manage the complete product sourcing process from research to store delivery. Key Responsibilities **1. Daily Product Research** - Research new and trending products across all categories in India. - Identify winning products with high demand and strong sales potential. - Research products trending on Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Instagram, YouTube, and other marketplaces. - Analyze product demand, competition, selling prices, customer reviews, and profit margins. - Identify products suitable for our business and customer base. **2. Manufacturer & Supplier Research** - Find genuine manufacturers, factories, and wholesale suppliers across India. - Contact manufacturers directly through phone, WhatsApp, and other channels. - Collect product catalogues, quotations, specifications, and videos. - Negotiate the best manufacturing and wholesale prices. - Verify supplier credibility and product quality. **3. End-to-End Product Procurement** - Coordinate samples and product testing. - Finalize product selection and purchase pricing. - Negotiate minimum order quantities and payment terms. - Arrange transportation from manufacturers to our Bangalore store. - Track orders until products are received at our store. - Maintain supplier and product databases. **4. Product Profitability Analysis** - Calculate total landed cost, including transportation and packaging. - Estimate selling price, marketplace competition, and profit margins. - Recommend only products with strong commercial potential. **5. Daily Reporting** - Submit daily product research reports. - Maintain a list of new products, manufacturers, prices, and estimated margins. - Track sourcing progress and pending supplier discussions. Candidate Requirements - Strong research and communication skills. - Experience in product sourcing, procurement, trading, or e-commerce preferred. - Ability to identify profitable products and market opportunities. - Comfortable speaking with manufacturers and negotiating prices. - Good knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets. - Self-motivated, target-oriented, and capable of working independently. Work Expectations - Full-time employment. - Daily product research and supplier communication. - Pan-India manufacturer and supplier sourcing. - Complete ownership of product research to store delivery. Position Product Research & Sourcing Executive – Full-Time **Apply:** Submit your resume with relevant experience and salary expectations. What I recommend for your business Don't hire someone just for searching products. Hire someone who can find a winning product and bring it all the way to your Bangalore store. Daily targets for this employee | Activity | Daily Target | | ----------------------------- | ------------ | | Research new products | 30–50 | | Shortlist potential products | 5–10 | | Find manufacturers | 5–10 | | Contact suppliers | 10–20 | | Detailed product analysis | 3–5 | | Final product recommendations | 1–2 | Important: Winning Product Research The employee should research products across: - Home & kitchen - Furniture - Toys & kids products - Electronics & accessories - Home improvement - Storage & organization - Lifestyle products - Trending Instagram products - Other high-demand, low-competition products Main objective: Find products that can sell consistently, have good margins, and can be sourced directly from manufacturers at competitive prices. I recommend the designation Product Research, Sourcing & Procurement Manager if you want one person to take complete responsibility for this entire process rather than just research.

This person will be responsible for finding winning products across India, researching manufacturers, negotiating prices, and getting products delivered to your store. Job Description – Product Research & Sourcing Executive Hiring: Product Research & Sourcing Executive **Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka\ **Job Type:** Full-Time | Work from Office About the Role We are looking for a dedicated Product Research & Sourcing Executive who can identify high-potential, trending, and profitable products across India and manage the complete product sourcing process from research to store delivery. Key Responsibilities **1. Daily Product Research** - Research new and trending products across all categories in India. - Identify winning products with high demand and strong sales potential. - Research products trending on Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Instagram, YouTube, and other marketplaces. - Analyze product demand, competition, selling prices, customer reviews, and profit margins. - Identify products suitable for our business and customer base. **2. Manufacturer & Supplier Research** - Find genuine manufacturers, factories, and wholesale suppliers across India. - Contact manufacturers directly through phone, WhatsApp, and other channels. - Collect product catalogues, quotations, specifications, and videos. - Negotiate the best manufacturing and wholesale prices. - Verify supplier credibility and product quality. **3. End-to-End Product Procurement** - Coordinate samples and product testing. - Finalize product selection and purchase pricing. - Negotiate minimum order quantities and payment terms. - Arrange transportation from manufacturers to our Bangalore store. - Track orders until products are received at our store. - Maintain supplier and product databases. **4. Product Profitability Analysis** - Calculate total landed cost, including transportation and packaging. - Estimate selling price, marketplace competition, and profit margins. - Recommend only products with strong commercial potential. **5. Daily Reporting** - Submit daily product research reports. - Maintain a list of new products, manufacturers, prices, and estimated margins. - Track sourcing progress and pending supplier discussions. Candidate Requirements - Strong research and communication skills. - Experience in product sourcing, procurement, trading, or e-commerce preferred. - Ability to identify profitable products and market opportunities. - Comfortable speaking with manufacturers and negotiating prices. - Good knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets. - Self-motivated, target-oriented, and capable of working independently. Work Expectations - Full-time employment. - Daily product research and supplier communication. - Pan-India manufacturer and supplier sourcing. - Complete ownership of product research to store delivery. Position Product Research & Sourcing Executive – Full-Time **Apply:** Submit your resume with relevant experience and salary expectations. What I recommend for your business Don't hire someone just for searching products. Hire someone who can find a winning product and bring it all the way to your Bangalore store. Daily targets for this employee | Activity | Daily Target | | ----------------------------- | ------------ | | Research new products | 30–50 | | Shortlist potential products | 5–10 | | Find manufacturers | 5–10 | | Contact suppliers | 10–20 | | Detailed product analysis | 3–5 | | Final product recommendations | 1–2 | Important: Winning Product Research The employee should research products across: - Home & kitchen - Furniture - Toys & kids products - Electronics & accessories - Home improvement - Storage & organization - Lifestyle products - Trending Instagram products - Other high-demand, low-competition products Main objective: Find products that can sell consistently, have good margins, and can be sourced directly from manufacturers at competitive prices. I recommend the designation Product Research, Sourcing & Procurement Manager if you want one person to take complete responsibility for this entire process rather than just research."

opportunities.title: Zoho CRM set-up for a marketplace partner onboarding journey
opportunities.description: We’re building a UK online marketplace. It depends on a steady flow of partner stores, restaurants, takeaways and wholesalers. We need a Zoho set-up that turns every new sign-up into a guided onboarding journey, tracks each partner’s progress in a clear pipeline, and prompts our team automatically at each step. Choosing the right Zoho products We think Zoho CRM on its own may be enough, but we’d like your advice. Please explain whether Zoho Creator or another Zoho app is needed, with the pros, cons, costs and complexity of each option. Please also say which Zoho CRM edition (Standard or Professional) each feature needs. We’ll agree the set-up with you before any configuration begins. What it needs to do A public online sign-up form sends partner details straight into Zoho. When a new partner record is created, the partner gets a branded welcome message and timed reminders. Messages go by WhatsApp or email, depending on each partner’s preferred contact method. Some partners don’t use email. WhatsApp should use Zoho’s own WhatsApp connection with Meta-approved message templates. Onboarding tasks are created and assigned to our team automatically. When a task is completed or a key field is updated, the partner moves to the next stage of a visual pipeline (Blueprint). Clear reports on partner numbers, time from sign-up to going live, and the history of follow-ups. Deliverables A short recommendation on the best Zoho product mix. Modules, fields and pipeline stages set up to match our onboarding steps. Automated emails, WhatsApp messages, tasks and stage moves, fully tested with sample data. One live sign-up form connected to Zoho. A short handover guide plus a screen-share session, so our team can run and maintain the system. How we work The Zoho account is in our company’s name, and we are the main administrator. You’ll get a user login for the project, which we’ll remove at handover. We need a UK/EU data centre and a signed NDA. We won’t share real partner data until both are in place. The work counts as complete when we have tested it and signed it off. Zoho licences are paid by us directly to Zoho, so please leave them out of your quote. We have a written set-up guide describing our fields, stages and messages. We’ll share it with shortlisted freelancers. Your quote Please send: A fixed price, broken down by deliverable. A proposed timeline. The Zoho edition you’re assuming. Any assumptions you’ve made.

opportunities.title: Corporate 3D Logo Design
opportunities.description: I need a corporate-feeling 3D logo that will act as our primary brand mark. The look I’m after is bold raised lettering with real depth—strong bevels, balanced shadows, and a polished finish that instantly communicates professionalism. The logo should feature only the company name; no symbols or extra graphics are required. Once the concept is approved, I’ll need the master 3D file plus high-resolution renders that are ready for print, slide decks, and social media. Deliverables • Editable 3D source file (Blender, Cinema4D, 3ds Max, OBJ or FBX) • 3000 px PNG renders on transparent and dark backgrounds • One 1080p MP4 turntable animation (5–10 s) showcasing the depth Clean kerning, consistent lighting, and crisp edges are essential. I’ll provide colour specs after kickoff. Please include examples of similar corporate 3D logos you’ve produced so I can gauge fit. Excited to see a confident, dimensional treatment of our name.

opportunities.title: Repair WordPress & Stop Spam
opportunities.description: My WordPress site — www.vivid.om — has two urgent issues. First, the pages suddenly look scrambled: layouts are off, colours and images sit where they shouldn’t, and overall it no longer resembles the theme I originally configured. Second, I’m being flooded with fake user sign-ups even though I don’t actively offer public registration. I need a developer who can: • Restore the site’s normal appearance and functionality without losing existing content. • Trace and shut down whatever route the bots are using to register, then harden WordPress so the problem doesn’t return (reCAPTCHA, honeypot, or another proven method). Please plan to work on a live install; I can supply full WP admin and cPanel access. Once you’re done I expect all pages to render correctly across desktop and mobile, and the registration spam to drop to zero. Let me know your preferred approach and an estimated turnaround.

opportunities.title: Mystery Shopper Telefónico Restaurantes CDMX
opportunities.description: Busco a alguien que realice llamadas de incógnito a distintos restaurantes y cafeterías dentro de la Ciudad de México y su zona metropolitana. El objetivo es evaluar, de forma discreta, cómo capturan los pedidos y los datos del cliente cuando se solicita un pedido sencillo del menú. Qué necesito: • De 10 a 15 llamadas distribuidas entre varios establecimientos que yo proporcionaré. • Registro detallado por llamada: fecha, hora, nombre del negocio, nombre del operador (si se proporciona) y transcripción breve. • Evaluación clara sobre la toma correcta de pedidos y datos (exactitud, repetición del pedido, confirmación de dirección o número de contacto, etc.). • Archivo de resultados en Google Sheets o Excel, más un comentario final con hallazgos generales y recomendaciones. Detalles clave: • El foco está únicamente en la fase de “Toma correcta de pedidos y datos”. No es necesario valorar amabilidad, tiempos de espera ni otros factores, salvo que afecten directamente a esa toma. • Todas las llamadas deben plantear pedidos sencillos del menú, sin cambios especiales ni órdenes grandes. • Las conversaciones deben mantenerse naturales; no reveles que se trata de una evaluación. • La información recopilada será de uso interno y confidencial. Entrego lista de números y un guion sugerido. Solo necesito las grabaciones (si tu equipo lo permite) y el reporte completo en un plazo máximo de una semana después de la adjudicación.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40808087, publicado hace 10 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: Por cotizar.

opportunities.title: Interior Designer Needed: 3D Renderings, Finish Schedule & Dimensional Layouts
opportunities.description: I am looking for a talented junior-to-intermediate interior designer or high-end e-designer to handle the aesthetic design for a large residential project. The project includes 9 major zones: • 1 Great Room • 1 Main Kitchen • 1 Spice Kitchen • 6 Washrooms I already have a seasoned builder executing the project to code and handles all structural/technical elements. I will provide you with the complete architectural floor plans in both PDF and CAD format. Your job will be strictly focused on the interior aesthetics, visual space planning, and material selections. Required Deliverables: 1. 3D Renderings: High-quality, photo-realistic 3D visual renderings (2–3 angles per room) showing the design concept. The style must be clean Modern or warm Transitional. 2. Detailed Finish Schedule: A comprehensive spreadsheet detailing all paint selections, flooring, tile placement, countertops, cabinet styles, and decorative lighting fixtures with clickable sourcing links. 3. Dimensional Layouts & Elevations: Using my CAD files, you must provide the precise aesthetic dimensions for the builder. This includes cabinet heights/widths, fireplace feature wall layout dimensions, and tile layout maps for the washrooms so the trades know exactly where to install materials.

Nos dedicamos a productos industriales o empresariales y necesitamos reforzar la presencia en ferias regionales y el contacto directo con distribuidores, mayoristas y comercios. El trabajo se extiende hasta 2027, de modo que valoro la constancia y la visión a largo plazo. Funciones del puesto: .Antes de la feria: llamar a los clientes potenciales Durante cada feria: recopilar los datos de posibles clientes con rigor y orden. • Después del evento: llamar a cada prospecto para presentar la empresa y pactar una reunión. • En la fase de cierre: visitar al cliente cuando sea necesario para afianzar la relación y avanzar en la negociación. Visitar los mercados locales en busca de clientes potenciales Perfil que encaja Eres meticuloso, sereno y analítico; disfrutas del trato telefónico y presencial; manejas tu propio calendario y cuidas cada seguimiento en un CRM o en hojas de cálculo compartidas. Experiencia previa en ventas B2B es indispensable. Si vives en una de las ciudades indicadas y quieres crecer conmigo en este mercado industrial, espero tu propuesta detallando tu experiencia específica y la disponibilidad para viajar dentro de tu región cuando se requiera.

opportunities.title: Looking for AI Automation Specialists & Ready-Made Software Solutions
opportunities.description: Looking for AI Automation Specialists & Ready-Made Software Solutions We are looking to connect with experienced software developers, SaaS specialists, and software product owners who have ready-made software solutions or innovative business software ideas. Our intention is to explore potential software business opportunities, particularly products that can be customised, rebranded, and commercially marketed. We are interested in: Ready-made SaaS platforms and business software. White-label software solutions. Custom software products with commercial potential. One-time licensed software or source-code solutions. AI-powered business tools and automation solutions. Unique software products suitable for small and medium businesses. What we expect from applicants: Please share your existing software products, demo links, key features, pricing, licensing terms, and any recurring costs. We are particularly interested in solutions with one-time purchase options, commercial resale rights, and minimal ongoing expenses. We are open to discussing potential purchases, customisation, and long-term business collaborations. IMPORTANT NOTE: We expect personalised proposals with actual product demos, working demo links, or relevant portfolios, rather than generic or copy-pasted messages. Proposals without relevant demos may not be considered.

opportunities.title: Cleaning Services Booking Platform Development
opportunities.description: # Website Development – Professional Cleaning Services Platform (Similar to Cleann.pt) We are looking for an experienced web developer or development team to design and develop a modern, professional, fully responsive website for a cleaning services company based in Portugal. **Reference Website:** https://www.cleann.pt/ We want a website with similar functionality, design quality and user experience to Cleann.pt, but with our own branding, colours, content and identity. ## 1. Website Design & Development - Modern, clean and professional design. - Fully responsive for desktop, tablet and mobile. - User-friendly navigation and attractive homepage. - Professional images, banners and service sections. - Fast loading speed and SEO-friendly structure. ## 2. Cleaning Services Management The website should support different cleaning services, including: - Regular Home Cleaning - Deep Cleaning - Office Cleaning - Airbnb Cleaning - Move-In / Move-Out Cleaning - Sofa & Mattress Cleaning - Window Cleaning - Post-Construction Cleaning - Housemaid Services - Commercial Cleaning Each service should have its own dedicated page with descriptions, pricing and booking options. ## 3. Online Booking System (Very Important) We need a complete online booking system where customers can: - Select their location or service area. - Choose the cleaning service. - Select property type and size. - Choose the number of cleaners. - Select cleaning duration. - Choose preferred date and available time slots. - Add additional services or special requests. - See automatic price calculations. - Enter their contact and property details. - Confirm their booking online. The booking system should automatically calculate the total price based on the customer's selections. ## 4. Admin Dashboard We require a backend administration panel where we can: - Manage all bookings. - View upcoming and completed appointments. - Manage customers and their information. - Add, edit or remove cleaning services. - Update prices and hourly rates. - Manage service areas. - Manage cleaner availability and schedules. - Assign cleaners to bookings. - Manage discounts and promotional offers. - View sales and booking reports. ## 5. Additional Features - WhatsApp integration. - Online payment gateway integration (Stripe / Multibanco / MB WAY, if supported). - Automatic booking confirmation emails. - Customer reviews and testimonials. - Google Reviews integration. - Google Maps integration. - Contact forms. - SEO optimization. - Google Analytics integration. ## 6. Language Support The website should support: - English - Portuguese The system should be designed so additional languages can be added later. ## 7. Technical Requirements - Secure and scalable development. - SEO-friendly URLs and structure. - Easy-to-manage CMS or custom admin panel. - Secure customer data management. - Integration with third-party services and APIs. - Full ownership and access to source code upon completion. ## 8. What We Expect From the Freelancer Please provide: 1. Examples of similar websites you have developed. 2. Your recommended technology and development approach. 3. Estimated project completion time. 4. Total development cost. 5. Details of ongoing maintenance and support. **Important:** We are not looking for just a simple company website. We need a complete cleaning services business platform with an automated online booking system, dynamic pricing and a powerful administration dashboard. We are looking for a long-term development partner who can deliver a high-quality, professional solution.

opportunities.title: Full-Stack Team for Multiseller SaaS
opportunities.description: Project Type: Custom Web Application / SaaS Development Engagement: Fixed-price, milestone-based Location: Remote / Worldwide Potential: Long-term development and maintenance Project Overview We are seeking an experienced full-stack developer or small development team to design and build a modern, scalable, cloud-based SaaS platform focused on e-commerce operations, third-party integrations and business process automation. The platform will provide users with a centralised interface to manage data, integrations and automated workflows across external services. We have a clear product direction and will provide detailed functional requirements to shortlisted candidates following initial discussions and a confidentiality agreement. The successful developer will be responsible for delivering a professional, secure, reliable and commercially deployable application. Scope of Work The initial development phase will include: 1. SaaS Application Development Modern, responsive web application Secure user registration, login and authentication User dashboard and account management Multi-tenant architecture supporting independent customer accounts Role-based permissions where required Subscription and billing integration 2. Third-Party API Integrations Integration with external e-commerce platforms Integration with third-party data providers Secure API authentication and credential management Data retrieval, processing and synchronisation Webhook handling and scheduled background tasks Appropriate API rate-limit handling 3. Workflow Automation Configurable automated processes Scheduled and event-driven operations Data validation and processing Error handling, retries and logging Monitoring and notification capabilities 4. Administration and Reporting Customer-facing dashboard Administrative management interface Operational reporting Activity history and audit logs Basic performance monitoring 5. Testing and Deployment Frontend and backend testing API integration testing Security and performance testing Cloud deployment and configuration Technical documentation Bug fixes and post-launch support Preferred Technology Stack We are open to recommendations but prefer modern, widely supported technologies. Frontend: React / Next.js / TypeScript Backend: Node.js / TypeScript Database: PostgreSQL / Supabase Hosting: Vercel, AWS or equivalent Version Control: GitHub Payments: Stripe Architecture: Scalable, modular and API-driven Developers should explain any proposed alternative technologies and their advantages. Required Experience Applicants must demonstrate proven experience in: Developing commercial SaaS applications Building complex API integrations E-commerce platform integrations, preferably Shopify Database design and multi-tenant architecture Workflow automation and background processing Secure authentication and payment integration Deploying and maintaining production web applications Experience with inventory systems, order management, data synchronisation or similar integration-heavy applications is highly desirable. Project Delivery Requirements We require a structured development approach with clearly defined milestones. The successful applicant must provide: Initial technical assessment and proposed architecture Detailed development plan and milestone schedule Working application delivered incrementally Regular progress demonstrations Access to the source code throughout development Testing and documentation Deployment to our nominated infrastructure Agreed post-launch defect support All source code, custom designs, documentation and intellectual property developed specifically for this project must be transferred to the client upon payment, subject to agreed third-party and open-source licensing. Development must take place in a GitHub repository controlled by the client. Hosting, database and other production accounts will also remain under client ownership. Confidentiality The project involves a proprietary commercial concept. Detailed product specifications, business logic, workflows and integration requirements will be shared only with shortlisted candidates under an appropriate confidentiality agreement. Applicants should be comfortable working under an NDA and signing an agreement covering intellectual property ownership. Timeline We are open to proposals based on a clearly defined MVP scope. Please provide a realistic development timeline, estimated cost and recommended team structure. Payments will be made through agreed milestones following demonstration, testing and acceptance of deliverables. How to Apply Please include the following in your proposal: A brief introduction outlining your relevant experience. Examples of at least two SaaS applications you have developed, preferably currently operational. Details of previous API integration or e-commerce automation projects. Your recommended technology stack and reasons for choosing it. Whether you work individually or as part of a team. Your estimated development timeline. Your proposed budget and milestone structure. Your availability to begin. Your approach to testing, security and ongoing maintenance. Important: Generic or automated proposals without relevant project examples will not be considered. We are looking for a reliable, technically capable development partner who can deliver high-quality work and potentially support the platform as it grows.

opportunities.title: Marketing Operations Co-Pilot | Virtual Assistant for Business Launch
opportunities.description: # Marketing Operations Co-Pilot | Virtual Assistant for Business Launch **Initial Project Budget:** $70 fixed price **Project Type:** Kickstart assignment with potential for long-term collaboration **Preferred Location:** Africa ## About the Opportunity We are building a growing business focused on African artisans, companies and locally made products, with both B2C and B2B audiences. We are looking for a proactive and resourceful Virtual Assistant to become a **Marketing Operations Co-Pilot**, working directly with the founder to help structure, coordinate and execute our marketing activities. This is not simply a social media posting assignment. We are looking for someone who can help turn ideas, existing materials and business priorities into consistent marketing operations. You will initially work on a small kickstart project, with the possibility of becoming a regular part of the team as the business develops. ## Initial Kickstart Project The first assignment will focus on getting our marketing operations moving. **1. Content and social media** - Review and organize existing brand materials, product information, photos and videos on Notion for the editorials then Google Drive folder for assets. - Draft social media posts with captions. - Suggest Story ideas and short-form video concepts. - Adapt communication for B2C and B2B audiences. **2. B2B and email marketing** - Prepare a B2B introduction and outreach template. - Draft an introductory newsletter. - Help organize product highlights and promotional messaging. **3. Marketing operations** - Organize marketing assets in Google Drive. - Improve our existing content-planning workflow using Notion or Google Sheets. - Prepare basic response templates for customer and business enquiries. - Establish a simple process for planning, approvals, follow-ups and tracking. **4. Coordination** - Maintain an overview of ongoing marketing tasks. - Follow up on missing information and pending actions. - Communicate progress and suggest practical improvements. - Help ensure that agreed activities move forward consistently. ## Expected Deliverables - Refining 3 month content calendar. - Social media posts ready for review. - One newsletter & Automation (we'll go through this altogether). - One B2B outreach template. - Organized marketing assets and a basic workflow. - Short handover with recommendations for the next steps. We will provide existing brand information, product materials and access to relevant tools. You will not need to visit workshops or produce original photography. ## The Person We Are Looking For - Experience in virtual assistance, marketing coordination or social media management. - Good written English; French or Arabic is a plus. - Comfortable using Canva, Google Drive and Notion or Google Sheets. - Organized, reliable and proactive. - Able to work independently and communicate clearly. - Interested in entrepreneurship, African products, crafts and emerging businesses. - Comfortable working in an evolving environment where initiative and problem-solving matter. ## Long-Term Possibility The initial assignment is a starting point, not necessarily the end goal. We want to find someone who can gradually become an integral part of our marketing operations, working alongside the founder and helping coordinate activities across content, social media, B2B communication, newsletters and campaign execution. Depending on performance, commitment, mutual fit and business growth, there may be opportunities for: - Regular paid collaboration as our Marketing Operations VA. - A full-time position within the business after an initial collaboration period. - A potential associate role with greater responsibility and involvement in the development of the business. We are particularly interested in someone who wants to grow with a business, take ownership and contribute beyond individual tasks. ## Budget and Application **Initial fixed budget: $70** To apply, answer these questions: 1. How would you approach the first 3 months to help us organize and kickstart our marketing operations? 2. Which tools and workflows have you used to coordinate marketing activities? 3. Can you share an example of relevant work you have completed? 4. Are you interested in growing into a long-term role, potentially full-time or as an associate, if the collaboration works well?

opportunities.title: Football Video Analysis Sales Rep
opportunities.description: Part-Time Football Sales Rep (Europe) – Sell Video Analysis to Clubs & Academies About BoomStats BoomStats is match video review for football clubs. Clubs upload their match footage, and BoomStats automatically drafts the key events, each with a video clip and its position on the pitch. The coach reviews and confirms them in minutes, then shares match reports and individual player reels with the squad. Coaches stop spending hours scrubbing through footage, and players get clips of their own performances. We’re an Australian company expanding into Europe and want people from the football world to bring BoomStats to clubs there. The role You’ll find and contact football clubs and academies in [countries], show them how BoomStats saves their coaches time, and book demos or free trials with our founder. You’ll be one of our first reps in Europe, so your feedback will directly shape how we sell there. Who you’ll be selling to Amateur, semi-pro and lower-league clubs that already film matches (or want to) Youth academies and football schools Head coaches, technical directors, analysts and club secretaries What you’ll do (about 10 hours a week, flexible) Build lists of clubs and academies in your region, and find the decision-maker at each Reach out by phone, email, WhatsApp, Instagram/Facebook and LinkedIn Use your football network: coaches, former teammates, league contacts Book demos or trials, and follow up until clubs sign up Collect feedback from clubs on what they need Log all activity in [CRM/Google Sheet] Join a 30-minute weekly call with the founder You’ll be a fit if you Have a football background: player, coach, analyst, academy staff or club volunteer Understand how clubs use video, and the pain of reviewing a full 90 minutes Have some sales, outreach or business development experience (any industry) Speak fluent English and [German / Spanish / Portuguese / Italian / Dutch / French] Are self-managed, reliable, and motivated by commission Are based in Europe Bonus points A UEFA coaching licence or performance analysis experience Hands-on use of match filming or analysis tools Existing contacts at clubs in a regional league or academy system Not a fit if you want a fixed salary with no targets, or plan to mass-message clubs with automated spam. How to apply Start your bid with “BOOMSTATS” so we know you read this (bids without it won’t be considered), then answer these: Which country or region and which languages can you cover? What’s your football background, and which clubs or academies do you have contacts at? Describe one sales or outreach result you’re proud of, with numbers. Write a short WhatsApp message to a youth academy coach introducing BoomStats (match footage in, key events and player reels out). How many hours a week can you commit? Shortlisted applicants do a paid 2-hour test task, then a 4-week paid trial.

opportunities.title: Automate WooCommerce EU Dropshipping at Scale
opportunities.description: FINAL PROJECT SPECIFICATIONS & DELIVERABLES (SCOPE OF WORK) Project Title: Enterprise-Level Multi-Channel WooCommerce Automation: Mass Import of 150K+ EU Products (CJ, Syncee, DropXL), Advanced API Sync, Stripe/PayPal Integration, and 100% Hands-Free Ecosystem. Project Description & Objective: To fully connect, technically optimize, and completely automate my WooCommerce store (www.euromalls.eu.com). The ultimate goal is to scale Euromalls into one of the largest online shopping malls in Europe, offering highly competitive pricing and fast shipping across the continent. The entire ecosystem must operate 100% "hands-free" on total autopilot. To build this massive catalog, the freelancer must execute a massive catalog injection from three suppliers (CJ Dropshipping, Syncee, and DropXL). The configuration must be strictly filtered to include 100% of the active product categories and listings distributed from any warehouse located within Europe (Spain, Germany, Poland, and all EU member states) to guarantee fast local delivery times (ranging from 24/72h to a maximum of 3-5 days EU-wide) DETAILED TECHNICAL DELIVERABLES (100% AUTOMATED & HANDS-FREE) 1. Massive 150K+ Reference Catalog Injection & Multi-API Sync • Massive EU Catalog Import: Configure the automated mass-import tools to inject over 150,000+ active references from: • CJ Dropshipping: 100% of active products located in Spain, Germany, Poland, and any other EU-based warehouses. • Syncee: 100% of products filtered for European-based suppliers. • DropXL: 100% of products available for European shipping. • Database & Server Optimization for 150K+ Products: The freelancer must optimize the WordPress database (indexes, transient cleanups) and server PHP settings (e.g., set WP_MEMORY_LIMIT to at least 768MB/1GB and adjust max_execution_time to 300+ seconds) to prevent timeouts, memory crashes, or server crashes during large imports. • Asynchronous "Batching" via Server Cron Jobs: Configure automated server Cron Jobs so that real-time stock and pricing synchronization checks are handled in staggered batches (updating categories at different intervals). This is a strict requirement to keep the front-end loading speeds hyper-fast for customers while managing massive live API traffic. • Automated Bulk Pricing Rules: Set up smart pricing formulas in the supplier backends to auto-calculate competitive retail pricing on WooCommerce while preserving strict profit margins after shipping and payment processing fees. 2. Mandatory "Hands-Free" Logistics & Order Fulfillment Loop The freelancer must ensure that the following three-step fulfillment loop works 100% in the background without any manual data entry or admin management: • Step A (Automatic Order Sync): The exact second a customer makes a successful purchase on WooCommerce, the complete order payload (buyer name, full EU shipping address, specific product SKU/variant) must be pushed via API to the respective supplier dashboard (CJ, Syncee, or DropXL) instantly and automatically. • Step B (Automated Supplier Payment): Set up and verify the Auto-Payment rules in the supplier backends (using digital wallets or linked corporate business cards). When an order is imported via API, the system must automatically pay the supplier cost using my balance, moving the order straight to "Pending Dispatch" without any manual button clicks. • Step C (Automatic Tracking & Completion): Once the European warehouse ships the package and generates the tracking number, the API must automatically sync it back to WooCommerce. The system must change the WooCommerce order status to "Completed" and automatically send the native WordPress shipping confirmation email to the customer with their tracking link. 3. Payment Gateways Integration • Stripe Integration: Install the official Stripe extension. Connect Live and Test API Keys. CRITICAL HANDS-FREE REQUIREMENT: You must fully configure and test Stripe Webhooks to ensure that WooCommerce instantly receives the "payment_intent.succeeded" signal, moving the order status to "Processing" to trigger the automated fulfillment loop without delay. • PayPal Integration: Install and configure PayPal Business Checkout. Enable Express Checkout buttons on both the product pages and the cart page. 4. European Tax & Compliance Setup (EU VAT) • Automated VAT Taxes: Activate WooCommerce native tax calculations. Configure standard European VAT rates ( 21% for Spain) so that the appropriate tax amount is dynamically added to the final checkout price based on the customer's shipping address. MANDATORY SIGN-OFF CRITERIA (THE LIVE TESTS) Before the project is marked as complete and funds are released, you must conduct a live End-to-End Test for each supplier platform using Test Mode/Sandbox credentials. A mock purchase must prove that the order flows instantly from WooCommerce to the supplier, gets paid automatically, and prepares for dispatch by the European warehouse WITHOUT PRESSING A SINGLE MANUAL BUTTON. BIDDING & ESTIMATION REQUIREMENTS (IMPORTANT FOR THE FREELANCER) When submitting your proposal, you must explicitly answer the following two questions: 1. Total Estimated Hours: Exactly how many hours of active work will it take you to complete the entire multi-platform integration, massive 150K+ product import, database optimization, and hands-free setup? (Note: I am looking for realistic timeframes between 12 to 18 hours of technical deployment; unrealistically short bids will be ignored). 2. Delivery Timeframe: What is the total turnaround time (in days) to deliver the project fully tested and ready for launch? Proposals that do not include the exact total hours and delivery days will be automatically ignored.

opportunities.title: Investigador/a en línea — Búsqueda de personas (Tlo / Idi) — Remoto...
opportunities.description: Buscamos un investigador/a remoto por contrato para localizar y verificar información de contacto actualizada de clientes potenciales. Es un puesto únicamente de investigación: no hay comunicación con clientes ni con clientes potenciales, y no se requiere inglés. El trabajoRealizar búsquedas en TLO (TLOxp) e IDI Data (idiCORE) para localizar números de teléfono, correos electrónicos y direcciones postales actuales Verificar y contrastar los resultados con registros públicos y otras fuentes para garantizar que la información sea actual y precisa Registrar los resultados en nuestra base de datos / software propietario, de forma limpia y organizada, indicando la fuente de cada dato Trabajar con nuestras cuentas acreditadas de las bases de datos, respetando estrictamente las reglas de uso permitido de cada plataforma Horario y pago De 6:00 a. m. A 2:00 p. m., Hora central de EE. UU., De 5 a 6 días por semana, contrato continuo Entre $5 y $7 USD por hora, según la experiencia Requisitos Experiencia práctica con tlo y/o idi data — indique qué plataformas ha utilizado, durante cuánto tiempo y con qué frecuencia experiencia en localización de personas (skip tracing), investigaciones, investigación para cobranzas, apoyo legal o trabajos de investigación similares sólidas habilidades de investigación en registros públicos y excelente atención al detalle computadora propia y conexión a internet estable discreción en el manejo de datos personales para postularse, responda las preguntas de selección a continuación. 1. ¿Qué bases de datos de búsqueda de personas ha utilizado personalmente: TLOxp, IDI Data (idiCORE), LexisNexis Accurint, Thomson Reuters CLEAR u otras? ¿Durante cuánto tiempo y cuántas búsquedas realiza en un día típico? 2. Cuando una búsqueda devuelve varias coincidencias posibles para el mismo nombre, explique paso a paso cómo confirma cuál es la persona correcta. 3. ¿Qué datos adicionales le ayudan más a acotar una búsqueda (fecha de nacimiento, última dirección conocida, nombres de familiares, un número de teléfono parcial)? 4. ¿Cómo verifica que un número de teléfono o correo electrónico encontrado esté vigente y pertenezca a esa persona, y no esté desactualizado o sea de otra persona? 5. Aproximadamente, ¿cuántos registros de contacto completamente verificados puede completar en un turno de 8 horas? 6. ¿Está disponible de 6:00 a. m. A 2:00 p. m., Hora central de EE. UU., De 5 a 6 días por semana, de forma continua? ¿Qué hora es esa en su lugar de residencia? 7. ¿Ha trabajado antes con la cuenta acreditada de bases de datos de un empleador? ¿Conoce las reglas de uso permitido de estas bases de datos? Categoría: Soporte Administrativo Subcategoría: Investigación de mercado ¿Cuál es el alcance del proyecto?: Para un producto, en un país

opportunities.title: Meta Instagram App Review Expert
opportunities.description: We are looking for an experienced freelancer to help prepare and support our Meta App Review submission for a chatbot platform, particularly Instagram messaging. All submissions will be made by us, with your preparation, guidance, and live assistance. We will retain control of our Meta accounts and app. Scope of work * Review our app configuration, chatbot use cases, requested permissions, and any previous rejection feedback. * Confirm the exact permissions and access levels required for our integration. * Identify missing prerequisites, including any applicable business or Tech Provider access verification requirements. * Prepare submission answers, permission justifications, screencast, reviewer instructions, and testing steps. * Help prepare and validate screencasts, test accounts, and demonstrations. * Guide us through the submission during a screen-sharing session. * Analyze Meta’s feedback and prepare corrections for resubmission. * Provide a final handover documenting the approved permissions and any ongoing requirements. If technical changes are needed, provide clear instructions for our development team. Significant development work must be quoted separately before work begins. Required experience and evidence You must have personally supported successful Instagram messaging App Review approvals. Please provide at least two examples, including: * Approval date and approved permissions. * Your specific role in preparing and securing the approval. * Any rejection reasons you resolved. General Meta advertising, Business Manager, or WhatsApp setup experience alone is insufficient for this project. Deadlines cover your work. Time awaiting Meta’s review, our documents, or development fixes is excluded. Any blocker must be reported promptly with the required next action. Resubmissions included Your fixed fee must include: * One initial submission. * Three resubmission rounds, including revised answers, reviewer instructions, screencasts where needed, and guided submission assistance. * Clarification responses related to those submissions. If an included submission is still awaiting Meta’s decision at that point, support for that round must continue through the response and its analysis. Additional rounds require a separately agreed price. Payment structure Please quote these separately: 1. Fixed fee: Paid against accepted deliverables—25% for the audit and the complete initial submission package and guided submission, and 75% after approval or completion of the included support scope. 2. Success fee: Paid only after Meta approves all permissions and access levels agreed in the initial audit, confirmed in our own App Dashboard. Partial approval does not trigger the success fee. Accepted fixed-fee deliverables remain payable regardless of Meta’s decision. Please include in your proposal * Your relevant approval evidence. * Your proposed fixed fee and separate success fee. * Confirmation that three resubmissions and the stated deadlines are included. * Your availability and what you need from us to begin. * Any exclusions or additional charges. We understand that Meta makes the final decision. We are looking for proven experience, accurate preparation, and responsive support throughout the review process.

opportunities.description: Necesito crear un paquete básico de personajes humanos listos para integrarse en Godot Engine. Los modelos deben tener una calidad media con un máximo de 10 000 polígonos y un rig bien organizado que permita equipar distintas armas sin problemas de deformación. Busco: • Modelo(s) humano(s) con esqueleto compatible con Godot, pesos correctamente pintados y materiales PBR simples. • Puntos de anclaje en las manos para que las armas se puedan acoplar o intercambiar fácilmente. • Conjunto de armas modeladas que incluya: – Pistola – Rifle – Escopeta – Arma cuerpo a cuerpo • Animaciones clave: idle con arma, caminar con arma en mano y disparo/ataque correspondiente para cada tipo de arma. Entrego el proyecto en Godot, por lo que agradeceré que los recursos vengan exportados en formatos compatibles (GLB/GLTF o DAE) y, si es posible, una pequeña escena de prueba que muestre el personaje cambiando de arma y ejecutando las animaciones. Quedo atento a tu propuesta, tiempos estimados y ejemplos de trabajos similares.

opportunities.title: Aplicación Web Consumo API
opportunities.description: Quiero una aplicación web que consuma mi servicio REST a través de varios endpoints protegidos con autenticación Bearer Token. El token ya estará embebido en la app, por lo que no habrá pantalla de inicio de sesión: solo necesito que cada petición incluya automáticamente el encabezado Authorization correspondiente. Alcance • Conectar a los endpoints que te proporcionaré e inyectar el Bearer Token en todas las llamadas. • Mostrar los datos en una interfaz limpia y responsive que funcione en cualquier navegador moderno. • Permitir al usuario ver la información y buscarla mediante filtros o cuadro de búsqueda. Requisitos técnicos • Puedes trabajar con React, Vue, Angular o vanilla JavaScript; elige la opción que mejor domines. • Manejo de estados y peticiones asíncronas con fetch, Axios o equivalente. • Estructura de archivos clara y comentada para que pueda mantenerla después. Entregables 1. Código fuente completo. 2. Breve guía de instalación/ejecución (README). 3. Demostración funcional alojada en un entorno temporal (por ejemplo Netlify, Vercel o similar) para revisión inicial. Valoraré un diseño simple pero pulido, uso correcto de promesas/async-await y buenas prácticas de seguridad al almacenar el token en memoria.

opportunities.title: Dubai and UAE Corporate AI Training Sales Associate
opportunities.description: B2B Sales Associate – Dubai & UAE Corporate AI Training Engagements (Commission-Based) About MedOS AI Tech University Website: www.medosaitech.com MedOS AI Tech University is an AI-focused professional training and technology education organization offering specialized enterprise training programs in: Generative AI Agentic AI Enterprise AI Architecture AI Engineering AI Agents and Multi-Agent Systems Enterprise AI Transformation AI Strategy and Governance We are expanding our international corporate training business and looking for a proactive, results-driven B2B Sales Associate to acquire corporate training clients across Dubai and the United Arab Emirates. This is a remote, commission-based opportunity with attractive earning potential. 1. Project Objective Your primary responsibility is to identify UAE organizations interested in AI workforce upskilling, approach corporate decision-makers, introduce our enterprise AI training programs, and secure paid online corporate training engagements. Our objective is to establish long-term corporate training partnerships with UAE enterprises, government-related organizations, universities and professional education providers. 2. Target Geography – Dubai & UAE We are looking for corporate training opportunities across: Dubai Abu Dhabi Sharjah Ajman Ras Al Khaimah Fujairah Other major UAE business hubs. Priority will be given to candidates with strong corporate networks in Dubai and Abu Dhabi. 3. Key Responsibilities Identify UAE companies interested in Generative AI and Agentic AI workforce training. Build a database of corporate prospects and decision-makers. Identify and approach: Chief Technology Officers (CTOs) Chief Information Officers (CIOs) Chief Human Resources Officers (CHROs) Learning & Development Directors HR Directors Digital Transformation Leaders AI Strategy and Innovation Heads Enterprise Architects Corporate Training Managers Conduct B2B cold emailing campaigns. Conduct business development calls to UAE companies. Execute LinkedIn outreach and relationship building. Introduce MedOS AI Tech University's corporate AI training solutions. Identify workforce training requirements, participant numbers and budgets. Schedule discovery meetings with corporate decision-makers. Coordinate proposals, commercial discussions and follow-ups. Convert qualified prospects into paid corporate training engagements. Maintain prospect information and sales activities in our CRM. 4. Training Programs to Sell Primary Offering: Enterprise Agentic AI Training Our corporate training programs cover: Generative AI Fundamentals Large Language Models (LLMs) Advanced Prompt Engineering Agentic AI Architecture AI Agents and Multi-Agent Systems LangChain and LangGraph Model Context Protocol (MCP) Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Enterprise AI Architecture AI Automation and Business Workflows Enterprise AI Security and Governance AI Application Development and Deployment AI Strategy and Enterprise Transformation Training programs can be customized according to the client's industry, technical requirements and employee skill levels. 5. Target Customers We are interested in engaging with: Large enterprises and multinational corporations Banking and financial services Real estate and construction companies Healthcare and hospital groups IT and telecommunications companies Government and semi-government organizations Aviation and logistics companies Energy and industrial organizations Consulting and professional services firms Universities and educational institutions Technology startups Corporate learning and development providers 6. Candidate Requirements Proven experience in B2B sales or corporate business development. Experience selling corporate training, IT services, SaaS or technology consulting. Excellent English communication and presentation skills. Arabic communication skills are an advantage. Experience selling to UAE enterprises is strongly preferred. Comfortable with cold calling, cold emailing and LinkedIn prospecting. Ability to communicate with senior corporate decision-makers. Familiarity with Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot or similar CRM tools. Ability to independently generate qualified business opportunities. Candidates based in Dubai, Abu Dhabi or elsewhere in the UAE with established corporate networks will be preferred. 7. Compensation Structure Engagement Type: Freelance / Independent Sales Associate Monthly Fixed Salary: No fixed salary. Compensation: Performance-based commission on successfully closed and collected corporate training revenue. Commission percentages and payment terms will be mutually agreed upon before onboarding. High-performing sales associates may be offered a long-term international business development partnership. 8. Monthly Performance Expectations Activity Monthly Target Corporate prospects identified 150 Decision-makers identified 100 Personalized cold emails 200 LinkedIn outreach 150 Follow-up calls 50 Qualified corporate meetings 8–10 Corporate proposals submitted 4–5 Paid training engagements 1–2 These are indicative targets and will be reviewed based on campaign performance. 9. What MedOS Provides Corporate AI training curriculum. Experienced AI trainers and technical subject matter experts. Trainer profiles and professional credentials. Corporate AI training brochures and presentations. Customized corporate training proposals. Pricing and commercial support. Technical support during client meetings. Online training delivery. Support throughout client onboarding. 10. Expected Deliverables The selected sales associate will be responsible for: Building a qualified UAE corporate prospect database. Identifying relevant decision-makers. Conducting email, LinkedIn and telephone outreach. Generating qualified corporate training leads. Scheduling meetings with interested organizations. Coordinating proposal submissions. Following up on commercial discussions. Securing paid corporate AI training engagements. 11. Important Conditions This is a business development and revenue-generation assignment, not merely a data-entry project. We are looking for candidates capable of converting prospects into paying corporate clients. All leads and sales activities must be recorded in the designated CRM. All prospects generated must remain within the MedOS sales pipeline. No unauthorized commitments or misleading representations about MedOS or its training programs. Commission is payable on eligible client payments actually received by MedOS. Sales associates must comply with applicable UAE marketing, privacy and telecommunications regulations. 12. How to Apply Please answer the following questions in your Freelancer proposal: Are you currently based in Dubai or elsewhere in the UAE? Which UAE cities do you have corporate contacts in? How many years of B2B corporate sales experience do you have? Have you previously sold corporate training or IT services in the UAE? Do you have experience approaching HR, L&D, CTO or CIO decision-makers? Are you fluent in English and Arabic? Can you independently conduct cold calling, email and LinkedIn campaigns? Which lead-generation and CRM tools do you use? How many qualified corporate meetings can you generate monthly? Are you comfortable working on a commission-only basis? Can you share examples of previous corporate sales achievements? About the Opportunity Organization: MedOS AI Tech University Website: www.medosaitech.com Market: Dubai & United Arab Emirates Service: Online Corporate AI Training Primary Focus: Agentic AI, Generative AI and Enterprise AI Architecture Engagement: Freelance / Remote / Commission-Based Initial Contract: 3 Months We are looking for ambitious B2B sales professionals who can help MedOS AI Tech University establish strong corporate training partnerships across Dubai and the UAE. If you have the ability to reach corporate decision-makers, generate business opportunities and close training engagements, we would love to work with you.

opportunities.title: Edición Limpia de Reels
opportunities.description: Estoy preparando una serie de contenidos cortos para Instagram, TikTok y YouTube Shorts. Dispongo del metraje bruto en formato vertical (1080 × 1920) y un breve outline por pieza. Quiero transformar cada clip en un video limpio y profesional, con edición sencilla: cortes precisos, ritmo fluido y sin efectos agresivos. Elementos imprescindibles • Música de fondo suave, libre de derechos, perfectamente sincronizada. • Exportación final en .mp4 H.264 1080 × 1920. • Archivo editable de CapCut (o equivalente) para ajustes posteriores. Opcional, pero bienvenido • Subtítulos cuando el audio no sea claro. • Miniatura estática con texto destacado siguiendo la estética del video. Alcance inicial: 10 videos de 30-60 s. Si el resultado encaja, el flujo será recurrente. Para coherencia visual facilitaré paleta, tipografía y logotipo. También escucho sugerencias sobre hooks, duración ideal y buenas prácticas de retención. Entregables por video 1. Video final listo para publicar. 2. Proyecto editable. 3. Assets utilizados (fuentes, música, etc.) con referencia de licencias. Indica tu tiempo estimado para el lote y ejemplos de trabajos similares.

opportunities.title: Solución Mensajes WhatsApp Cloud API
opportunities.description: Estoy atascado con la Meta WhatsApp Cloud API: mis mensajes no salen ni entran. El número está verificado, dispongo del token de acceso y del phone_number_id, pero algo en la configuración —webhook, permisos o llamadas al endpoint— impide el flujo completo. Busco a alguien con experiencia comprobable depurando la Cloud API, que pueda: Envié documentos de verificación de negocio y lleva varias semana en estado EN REVISION Trabajo en tiempo real (Zoom/Meet + Postman o similar) hasta ver al menos un mensaje saliente y uno entrante funcionando. Así confirmamos juntos que el problema queda resuelto y cierro el proyecto.

opportunities.title: Planos completos vivienda una planta
opportunities.description: Necesito un profesional que desarrolle el paquete completo de planos para una casa de una sola planta en un terreno inferior a 150 m². Requiero que el juego incluya: • Arquitectura: plantas, cortes, fachadas y cuadro de áreas • Estructura: cimentación, detalles de losas, vigas y columnas, con memorias de cálculo básicas • Instalaciones: esquemas y planos de electricidad, hidráulica y sanitaria con su respectiva simbología Entrego el programa de necesidades y las medidas exactas del predio una vez iniciado el trabajo; espero retroalimentación sobre distribución y soluciones constructivas antes de cerrar la versión final. Los archivos deben entregarse en formato editable (DWG) y PDF listos para impresión, respetando normas locales y escalas estándar. Aprecio propuestas claras, plazos realistas y muestras de proyectos similares. Requisitos del profesional * Hablar español. * Tener experiencia comprobable en proyectos residenciales. * Presentar ejemplos de trabajos anteriores. * Poder trabajar a partir de un diseño arquitectónico existente. * Mantener comunicación directa durante el desarrollo del proyecto. ### Para postularse Para evitar propuestas automáticas y perfiles que no hayan leído la descripción, es obligatorio comenzar la propuesta escribiendo la siguiente palabra clave: CASA VZ 2026

opportunities.title: Campaña Afiliados Servicios Funerarios Chile
opportunities.description: Estamos buscando traffickers digitales, especialistas en performance marketing y afiliados independientes que quieran generar ingresos mediante la captación de clientes interesados en servicios de cementerio, funerarios, cremación y sepulturas. Buscamos personas o agencias con experiencia en campañas digitales, generación de leads calificados y adquisición de clientes, que puedan desarrollar estrategias comerciales orientadas a resultados. Canales de adquisición: * Meta Ads: Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads y campañas de generación de leads. * Google Ads: Search, Performance Max, Display y YouTube Ads. * TikTok Ads: campañas de captación y generación de demanda. * SEO y posicionamiento orgánico: captación de clientes mediante búsquedas de alta intención. * WhatsApp Marketing: estrategias de conversión y derivación de prospectos. * Email Marketing y automatizaciones: captación, remarketing y recuperación de oportunidades. * Marketing de afiliados: redes de referidos, sitios web, comunidades digitales y plataformas de generación de demanda. ¿Qué buscamos? Personas con experiencia en adquisición digital que puedan gestionar sus propias campañas, identificar oportunidades comerciales y generar prospectos con intención real de contratación. El modelo de colaboración estará orientado a resultados, con comisiones por ventas efectivamente concretadas, según el producto y las condiciones comerciales acordadas. ¿Qué ofrecemos? * Oportunidad de generar ingresos mediante comisiones por ventas. * Portafolio de servicios con demanda permanente. * Posibilidad de colaboración comercial de largo plazo. * Modelo de trabajo flexible e independiente. * Potencial de crecimiento según resultados y volumen de ventas. ¿Te interesa participar? Si tienes experiencia gestionando campañas en Google Ads, Meta Ads u otros canales de adquisición y buscas monetizar tus habilidades en marketing digital, queremos conocerte. Escríbenos indicando tu experiencia, canales que gestionas, volumen de leads que puedes generar y modalidad de trabajo. ¡Buscamos aliados estratégicos para potenciar la generación de demanda y nuevas oportunidades comerciales!
